name: OpenVibe.Deals

exposure.note: the domain serves the OpenVibe.Sites placeholder page

site.name: Deals
site.what: Deals submitted and voted on by the community, with source, price and freshness always shown.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

drains: worker stopped (expiry, hotness, freshness, Sources, housekeeping)

resumes.what: the next worker tick applies stated expiries, hotness and freshness that fell due; every step is idempotent
the OpenVibe.Sources change feed is pulled again from the stored cursor, so items published during the stop arrive (idempotent per item revision)
unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

leases.none: no claims: one process owns deals.db (better-sqlite3, single writer)

notes: Port 4840. Owns deal_products, deal_product_aliases, deal_offers, deal_offer_sources, deal_votes, deal_hotness_snapshots, deal_watches, deal_price_observations, deal_flags (+ deal_stores) in its own SQLite. Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO, identity.subject.resolve), OpenVibe.Sources (sources.item.read; sources.item.* events only wake the pull), OpenVibe.Community (community.comment.write, community.comment.moderate) and publishes through OpenVibe.Events (events.event.publish); OpenVibe.Search reads deals.index_document.* from Events; OpenVibe.Network turns deals.watch.matched into notifications (server/notifications/events-consumer.js).
